desc:
Boat around and earn credits to buy more expensive boats!
Please note that you MAY get lag spikes while the game is loading!

TUBING, SKIING, WAKEBOARDING, WAKE SURFING, KITE TUBING!!!

Current Features:
 - [NEW] PLANING PHYSICS!
 - Ferry job!
 - Minimap
 - Marina spawner
 - Five marinas
 - Houses
 - Spawning system
 - Credits system
 - Credits shop
 - TREES!!!!
 - Console support!

Boat Chassis link: https://www.roblox.com/library/5826928666/
Join our server to see when new updates to the chassis and the game release!
